record.question: Which of the following is a key component of the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme?
options: Universal free health insurance for all children
Mandatory school enrollment at age three
record.explanation: Answer B: Supplementary nutrition and growth monitoring. ICDS includes supplementary nutrition, growth monitoring, health check-ups, referral, and preschool education through Anganwadi services. Reference: https://wcd.gov.in/schemes/integrated-child-development-services-icds-scheme. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
